subject: One-off protection discount request — HoloHealth pilot (VP/CFO signoff needed)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: One-off protection discount request — HoloHealth pilot (VP/CFO signoff needed)

Hi Marissa —

Quick ask: HoloHealth is ready to sign but needs a one-off 35% commercial discount on the pilot (12-month term, committed 120M tokens / $180k ARR equivalent) to keep the PO moving. Rationale: they are taking a VPC deployment and require additional SRE engagement for the first 90 days; they want a case study and reference, and they’ve committed to a product roadmap integration that should expand into a 3x volume next year if we get the pilot live by Nov.

What I’m proposing:
- 35% list discount for the first 12 months (pilot only)
- Standard T&Cs otherwise; attach term sheet + redline SOW for the VPC/sre add-on
- Conditional make-good: if usage exceeds 150M tokens in month 6 we revert to standard pricing for incremental tokens

Why I think this is approvable: this is a strategic health-system reference (HoloHealth has a network of regional clinics and an integration pipeline) and they’ve already committed to procurement and engineering timelines. Finance margin hit is non-trivial but recoverable through the VPC fee and the case study motion.

Attachments: HoloHealth_term_sheet_v2.pdf, redline_Redwood_standard_SOW.docx

Asking for: VP or CFO signoff for a one-off commercial protection discount and authority to finalize the PO by EOD Friday.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Strategic Health
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: One-off protection discount request — HoloHealth pilot (VP/CFO signoff needed)

Thanks for the concise write-up — good job capturing the commercial trigger. A few quick clarifying questions before I escalate to execs:
1) Is the 35% off list across all billable units or just on base compute tokens? Please confirm effective unit and any carveouts (embeddings, search rerank).
2) What is the proposed termination / step-down if they churn after pilot?
3) Confirm that legal is comfortable with the VPC SRE language in the redline; if Priyom flags anything material we should hold.

If answers are clean I’m happy to route this to the CFO for signoff with my endorsement. I’ll also include a short cover memo outlining precedent (any similar one-off in last 12 months).

Marissa
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: One-off protection discount request — HoloHealth pilot (VP/CFO signoff needed)

Checked the numbers with Sales Ops. Quick notes:
- Current forecasted blended unit margin at list for this pilot = ~48%. With the proposed 35% off, blended margin falls to ~27% (before VPC fee).
- VPC setup + dedicated SRE estimated one-time cost to Redwood: $28k (includes 90-day on-call). We can recoup $15k via an elevated VPC provisioning fee in month 1 — still leaves material margin pressure.
- Precedent: in last 12 months we approved two one-offs in healthcare verticals for up to 30% (conditional), both required at least VP commercial + Finance director signoff.

Recommendation: escalate to Markus for Finance position and request explicit CFO signoff given margin >20% impact and strategic upside. If Finance wants to limit to 30% I support that as a middle ground.

-Karthik
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: One-off protection discount request — HoloHealth pilot (VP/CFO signoff needed)

Appreciate the detail. Finance position:
- We can support a one-off commercial discount but need to limit direct list discount to 30% for the pilot. Any additional concession should be structured as a time-bound onboarding credit (cap $25k) that is recognized over the first 3 months.
- Require the VPC provisioning fee to be invoiced as a one-time setup charge (no hidden margin absorption).
- Legal (Priyom) to confirm indemnity and data residency language; if legal flags additional risk we may need escalation to the CFO for final judgment.

I will not sign as CFO on this margin impact; routing to exec/cfo is appropriate. Marissa — if you can append a 1-paragraph cover memo (commercial rationale + precedent) I will include it in the packet to the CFO.

-Markus
Director, Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Executive approval requested: HoloHealth one-off pilot discount (packet attached)

CFO / Exec team —

Please see attached packet for a one-off commercial request for HoloHealth Inc. (Deal ID DEAL-2026-1374). Summary below:
- Request: 35% off list for a 12-month pilot with committed 120M tokens (~$180k ARR list).
- Finance (Markus) recommends approval at 30% direct list discount + $25k capped onboarding credit recognized over first 3 months.
- Rationale: VPC + SRE onboarding, strategic health-system reference, expected 3x volume in year two tied to roadmap commitments.
- Conditions: elevated one-time VPC provisioning fee to offset setup costs; make-good clause if usage ramps early; legal sign-off on data residency and indemnity.

I endorse the ask as VP, Commercial given the strategic value and speed-to-close; I recommend CFO signoff on the finance counterproposal (30% + $25k credit) to keep this moving by EOD Friday given procurement timelines.

Attachments: HoloHealth_term_sheet_v2.pdf, redline_Redwood_standard_SOW.docx

Thanks — happy to discuss.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
